name: truncate_dangling_symlink
description: truncate -s0 through dangling symlink creates target file
cmd_prep: rm -f t-symlink truncate-target && ln -s truncate-target t-symlink
cmd_target: BINARY -s0 t-symlink && test -f truncate-target && echo OK

name: truncate_dir_fail
description: truncate on a directory must fail

name: truncate_fail_no_such_dir
description: truncate -s0 to file in non-existent dir fails with diagnostic

name: truncate_fail_trailing_slash
description: truncate -s0 to non-existent dir with trailing slash fails

name: truncate_fifo
description: truncate -s0 on a fifo completes without hanging

name: truncate_no_create_missing
description: truncate -c on missing file should not fail
cmd_target: BINARY -s0 -c no-such-file; echo exit=$?; test -e no-such-file && echo CREATED || echo NOT_CREATED

name: truncate_overflow_minus
description: truncate -s-1 creates a zero-length file (negative size clamped)
cmd_target: BINARY -s-1 create-zero-len-file; echo exit=$?; stat -c %s create-zero-len-file 2>/dev/null

name: truncate_overflow_signed
description: truncate -s with signed-overflow value must fail

name: truncate_overflow_relative_plus
description: truncate -s+OFF_T_MAX on non-empty file overflows and fails

name: truncate_overflow_io_blocks
description: truncate --io-blocks with size that overflows must fail

name: truncate_no_files
description: truncate --size=0 with no files must fail

name: truncate_no_size
description: truncate without --size or --reference must fail

name: truncate_size_and_reference
description: truncate --size and --reference are mutually exclusive

name: truncate_io_blocks_no_size
description: truncate --io-blocks without --size is invalid

name: truncate_invalid_size
description: truncate --size=invalid must fail

name: truncate_size_negative_with_modifier
description: truncate --size='> -1' must fail

name: truncate_size_extend_to_one
description: truncate --size=' >1' extends file to 1 byte

name: truncate_size_relative_plus_one
description: truncate --size=' +1' grows file by 1 byte
cmd_prep: rm -f file && dd if=/dev/zero of=file bs=1 count=1 status=none

name: truncate_reference_with_relative
description: truncate --reference allowed with relative size
cmd_prep: rm -f file && dd if=/dev/zero of=file bs=1 count=2 status=none

name: truncate_reference_alone
description: truncate -r alone copies size from reference
cmd_prep: rm -f file && dd if=/dev/zero of=file bs=1 count=3 status=none

name: truncate_reference_to_other
description: truncate -r copies reference size to a different file
cmd_prep: rm -f file file2 && dd if=/dev/zero of=file bs=1 count=3 status=none

name: truncate_relative_mixed_modifiers_a
description: truncate --size='+>0' (mixed relative modifiers) must fail

name: truncate_relative_mixed_modifiers_b
description: truncate --size='>+0' (mixed relative modifiers) must fail

name: truncate_relative_div_by_zero
description: truncate --size='/0' must fail (division by zero)

name: truncate_relative_mod_by_zero
description: truncate --size='%0' must fail (modulo by zero)
